statement: With degrees of freedom and scale held, every attained Student fit is unique for Lebesgue-almost every sample of size at least three.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : ∀ᵐ x : Fin n → ℝ ∂volume, ∀ c d : ℝ, IsMaxOn (fun p ↦ studentLocationLogLik a p x) univ c → IsMaxOn (fun p ↦ studentLocationLogLik a p x) univ d → c = d
dossier_scope_note: Almost-everywhere result for at least three observations. The atlas two-observation counterexample is a different claim.

statement: The limiting scaled EMG polynomial has exactly two equal global peaks on the nonnegative shape axis.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) : crossingPolynomial v ≤ 16 / 23 ∧ (crossingPolynomial v = 16 / 23 ↔ v = 1 ∨ v = 2)
dossier_scope_note: Exact limiting-polynomial calculation for the two finite co-winners. The EMG sample construction remains open in Lean.

statement: A continuous crossing of two disjoint compact windows gives two finite all-free EMG maximizers, provided the rest of the profile stays below the larger window value throughout the crossing.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (x : ℝ → Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (hx : ∀ A ∈ Icc a b, LocationScale.Nonconstant (x A)) (hi : ∀ A ∈ Icc a b, ∀ j, x A i ≤ x A j) {K J : Set ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hJ : IsCompact J) (hneK : K.Nonempty) (hneJ : J.Nonempty) (hdis : Disjoint K J) (hKsub : K ⊆ Ioo 0 1) (hJsub : J ⊆ Ioo 0 1) (hwindow : ContinuousOn (fun A ↦ sSup (compactProfile (x A) i '' J) - sSup (compactProfile (x A) i '' K)) (Icc a b)) (ha : sSup (compactProfile (x a) i '' J) ≤ sSup (compactProfile (x a) i '' K)) (hb : sSup (compactProfile (x b) i '' K) ≤ sSup (compactProfile (x b) i '' J)) (hgap : ∀ A ∈ Icc a b, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, t ∉ K → t ∉ J → compactProfile (x A) i t ≤ max (sSup (compactProfile (x A) i '' K)) (sSup (compactProfile (x A) i '' J))) : ∃ A ∈ Icc a b, let S := Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ LocationScale.domain let L := fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ shapeLogLik (x A) ((1-p.1)/p.1) p.2 ∃ p ∈ S, ∃ q ∈ S, p ≠ q ∧ IsMaxOn L S p ∧ IsMaxOn L S q
dossier_scope_note: Conditional on the two-window crossing and exterior comparison. Does not construct an exact EMG sample.

statement: Without a finite fit at held rate, every finite location and scale strictly loses to the compatible moving exponential. That face is the least upper bound, including for constant observations.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {rate : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) : let S := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density rate p.1 p.2 (x j) let B := ∏ j, rate * Real.exp (-rate * (x j - x i)) (¬ ∃ p ∈ S, IsMaxOn L S p) ↔ (∀ p ∈ S, L p < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' S) B

statement: As scale tends to zero at held rate, every tied contact contributes the same CDF factor. The three options are a finite standardized contact, a contact approached from below at a greater distance than the scale, and the opposite infinite standardized contact.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {α : Type*} {l : Filter α} {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {rate c penalty : ℝ} {s μ : α → ℝ} (hs : Tendsto s l (𝓝[>] 0)) (hμ : Tendsto μ l (𝓝 c)) (hcontact : (∃ h : ℝ, penalty = Φ h ∧ Tendsto (fun t ↦ (c - μ t) / s t) l (𝓝 h)) ∨ (penalty = 1 ∧ Tendsto (fun t ↦ (c - μ t) / s t) l atTop) ∨ (penalty = 0 ∧ Tendsto (fun t ↦ (c - μ t) / s t) l atBot)) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ ∏ j, density rate (μ t) (s t) (x j)) l (𝓝 (∏ j, rate * Real.exp (-rate * (x j - c)) * (if c < x j then 1 else if x j = c then penalty else 0)))
dossier_scope_note: Finite limiting location and convergent standardized contact, including both infinite contact limits.

statement: For held rate and location, the zero-scale trace includes half density at each contact, and the infinite-scale trace vanishes.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {rate μ : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) : Tendsto (fun s ↦ ∏ j, density rate μ s (x j)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (exponentialTrace x rate μ)) ∧ Tendsto (fun s ↦ ∏ j, density rate μ s (x j)) atTop (𝓝 0)

statement: For held location and scale, zero rate gives zero and infinite rate gives the matched normal product.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {μ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : Tendsto (fun rate ↦ ∏ j, density rate μ σ (x j)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun rate ↦ ∏ j, density rate μ σ (x j)) atTop (𝓝 (normalTrace x μ σ))

statement: At fixed rate and location, failure of a finite maximum is strict loss to the zero-scale face, which is then the exact supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {rate μ : ℝ} (hr : 0 < rate) : let S := Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun s ↦ ∏ j, density rate μ s (x j) let B := exponentialTrace x rate μ (¬ ∃ p ∈ S, IsMaxOn L S p) ↔ (∀ p ∈ S, L p < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' S) B

statement: At fixed location and scale, failure of a finite maximum is strict loss to the infinite-rate normal face, which is then the exact supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {μ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : let S := Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun rate ↦ ∏ j, density rate μ σ (x j) let B := normalTrace x μ σ (¬ ∃ p ∈ S, IsMaxOn L S p) ↔ (∀ p ∈ S, L p < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' S) B

statement: At held Gaussian scale, a finite location and rate attain exactly when a finite fit reaches the matched normal value at the sample mean.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : let S := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density p.2 p.1 σ (x j) let B := normalTrace x (Normal.mean x) σ (∃ p ∈ S, IsMaxOn L S p) ↔ ∃ p ∈ S, B ≤ L p

statement: At held Gaussian scale, nonattainment occurs exactly when the normal face at the sample mean is strictly above every finite candidate.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : let S := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density p.2 p.1 σ (x j) let B := normalTrace x (Normal.mean x) σ (¬ ∃ p ∈ S, IsMaxOn L S p) ↔ (∀ p ∈ S, L p < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' S) B

statement: With location held and a nonzero residual, the exponential face is maximized at the exponential rate of the residuals when compatible. If any residual is negative, its whole face is zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {μ : ℝ} (hx : ∃ i, x i ≠ μ) : let B := if ∀ j, μ ≤ x j then exponentialTrace x (Exponential.rate (fun j ↦ x j - μ)) μ else 0 IsGreatest ((fun r ↦ exponentialTrace x r μ) '' Ioi 0) B
dossier_scope_note: Optimization of the exponential face on the nonzero-residual branch.

statement: With location held, all-zero residuals give unbounded likelihood along the fixed standardized-rate collapse.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {μ : ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, x i = μ) : ¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density p.1 μ p.2 (x j)) '' (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0))

statement: At held location, a finite fit requires a nonzero residual and a finite value reaching both optimized face values.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) : let S := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density p.1 μ p.2 (x j) let N := normalTrace x μ (Normal.sd x μ) let E := if ∀ j, μ ≤ x j then exponentialTrace x (Exponential.rate (fun j ↦ x j - μ)) μ else 0 (∃ p ∈ S, IsMaxOn L S p) ↔ (∃ i, x i ≠ μ) ∧ ∃ p ∈ S, max N E ≤ L p

statement: For a nonzero held-location residual, if no finite point wins, the larger optimized normal and exponential face is the exact supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) (hx : ∃ i, x i ≠ μ) : let S := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density p.1 μ p.2 (x j) let N := normalTrace x μ (Normal.sd x μ) let E := if ∀ j, μ ≤ x j then exponentialTrace x (Exponential.rate (fun j ↦ x j - μ)) μ else 0 (¬ ∃ p ∈ S, IsMaxOn L S p) ↔ (∀ p ∈ S, L p < max N E) ∧ IsLUB (L '' S) (max N E)
dossier_scope_note: Nonzero-residual branch.

statement: At held Gaussian scale and constant data, every feasible fit strictly loses to the normal at the common observation.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : ∀ μ rate : ℝ, 0 < rate → (∏ _ : Fin n, density rate μ σ m) < normalTrace (fun _ : Fin n ↦ m) m σ
dossier_scope_note: Constant-data branch.

statement: If a symmetric sample has a nonzero-slant finite winner, reflection at zero produces a distinct finite winner of the same height.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (e : Fin n ≃ Fin n) (hx : ∀ j, x (e j) = -x j) {α ξ ω : ℝ} (hα : α ≠ 0) (hm : IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ logLik q.1 x q.2) (univ ×ˢ LocationScale.domain) (α, ξ, ω)) : (α, ξ, ω) ≠ (-α, -ξ, ω) ∧ IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ logLik q.1 x q.2) (univ ×ˢ LocationScale.domain) (-α, -ξ, ω)
dossier_scope_note: Conditional on a nonzero-slant winning fit on a symmetric sample.

statement: At fixed slant, a constant sample has no finite fit and an unbounded log likelihood.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m α : ℝ) : (¬ BddAbove (logLik α (fun _ : Fin n ↦ m) '' LocationScale.domain)) ∧ ¬ ∃ p ∈ LocationScale.domain, IsMaxOn (logLik α (fun _ : Fin n ↦ m)) LocationScale.domain p

statement: With positive scale and finite slant held, every nonempty sample has exactly one maximizing location.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (α : ℝ) {ω : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : ∃! ξ, IsMaxOn (fun m ↦ logLik α x (m,ω)) univ ξ

statement: For fixed slant and location, exactly one positive scale maximizes as soon as a residual is nonzero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (ξ α : ℝ) (hx : ∃ i, x i ≠ ξ) : ∃! ω, ω ∈ Ioi 0 ∧ IsMaxOn (fun s ↦ logLik α x (ξ,s)) (Ioi 0) ω
dossier_scope_note: Nonzero residual branch, with collapse covered separately.

statement: With location and slant held, zero residuals cause unbounded scale collapse.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (ξ α : ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i = ξ) : ¬ BddAbove ((fun s ↦ logLik α x (ξ,s)) '' Ioi 0)

statement: With slant and location held, scale attains exactly when a residual is nonzero. The maximum is unique throughout that branch.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (ξ α : ℝ) : (∃ ω ∈ Ioi 0, IsMaxOn (fun s ↦ logLik α x (ξ,s)) (Ioi 0) ω) ↔ ∃ i, x i ≠ ξ

statement: With location and scale held, both strict residual signs give exactly one maximizer and all-zero residuals give the whole slant line. A lone strict residual sign precludes a finite maximum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ) {ω : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) : let M := fun α ↦ IsMaxOn (fun β ↦ logLik β x (ξ,ω)) univ α let Signs := (∃ j, ξ < x j) ∧ (∃ j, x j < ξ) let Zero := ∀ j, x j = ξ ((∃ α, M α) ↔ Signs ∨ Zero) ∧ (Signs → ∃! α, M α) ∧ (Zero → ∀ α, M α)

statement: Under either single strict residual sign, the held-location and held-scale supremum is the compatible half-normal trace with half density per contact. Every finite slant loses strictly.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {ξ ω : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) (hside : ((∀ j, ξ ≤ x j) ∧ ∃ j, ξ < x j) ∨ ((∀ j, x j ≤ ξ) ∧ ∃ j, x j < ξ)) : IsLUB (range (fun α : ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density α ξ ω (x j))) (oneSidedEnvelope x ξ ω) ∧ ∀ α : ℝ, (∏ j, density α ξ ω (x j)) < oneSidedEnvelope x ξ ω

statement: With location held, a finite fit exists exactly when both strict residual signs occur. In that case the full fit is unique.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ) : let S := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let M := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ p ∈ S ∧ IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ logLik q.1 x (ξ,q.2)) S p let Signs := (∃ j, ξ < x j) ∧ (∃ j, x j < ξ) ((∃ p, M p) ↔ Signs) ∧ (Signs → ∃! p, M p)

statement: At held location with one strict residual sign, the compatible half-normal trace is optimized at the residual RMS. All finite joint fits lose strictly to that reachable bound.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ) (hside : ((∀ j, ξ ≤ x j) ∧ ∃ j, ξ < x j) ∨ ((∀ j, x j ≤ ξ) ∧ ∃ j, x j < ξ)) : let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density p.1 ξ p.2 (x j) let S := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let B := oneSidedEnvelope x ξ (Normal.sd x ξ) IsLUB (L '' S) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, L p < B
dossier_scope_note: One strict sign, with any ties.

statement: With location held at all observations, free scale permits collapse even if the slant is held at any chosen finite value along the path.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ) (hx : ∀ j, x j = ξ) : ¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ logLik p.1 x (ξ,p.2)) '' ((univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
dossier_scope_note: All-zero residual branch.

statement: Constant observations at held scale give the same excluded height on both moving half-normal faces, and every finite location and slant loses.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℝ) {ω : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) : let B := (2 * φ 0 / ω)^n (∀ α ξ : ℝ, (∏ _ : Fin n, density α ξ ω m) < B) ∧ Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ ∏ _ : Fin n, density (t^2) (m-t⁻¹) ω m) atTop (𝓝 B) ∧ Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ ∏ _ : Fin n, density (-(t^2)) (m+t⁻¹) ω m) atTop (𝓝 B)
dossier_scope_note: Constant-sample branch.

statement: Width zero includes the normal collapse on every nonempty constant sample, so the fully free likelihood is unbounded.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℝ) : let x : Fin n → ℝ := fun _ ↦ m let S := Ici (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Normal.domain let L := fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 ¬ BddAbove (L '' S)
dossier_scope_note: Constant-data branch.

statement: For nonnegative held width, attainment at zero width is precisely the ordinary normal criterion. At positive width the range must exceed twice the held width.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : (∃ p ∈ Normal.domain, IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x a p.1 p.2) Normal.domain p) ↔ if a = 0 then (∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) else (∃ i j, 2*a < x j - x i)

statement: When the held positive width strictly covers the sample range, the unpenalized uniform likelihood is the exact supremum and every finite fit loses strictly.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {i j : Fin n} (hlo : ∀ k, x i ≤ x k) (hhi : ∀ k, x k ≤ x j) (hspan : x j - x i < 2*a) : let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x a p.1 p.2 let B := (1 / (2*a))^n IsLUB (L '' Normal.domain) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ Normal.domain, L p < B
dossier_scope_note: Strict coverage. Endpoint equality is already in HeldSweepBhatt.range_equality_height.

statement: At held width zero and held centre, a finite scale fit exists exactly when at least one residual is nonzero, and the fit is unique.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) : (∃! s, s ∈ Ioi 0 ∧ IsMaxOn (likelihood x 0 m) (Ioi 0) s) ↔ ∃ j, x j ≠ m
dossier_scope_note: Zero-width normal seam.

statement: At positive held physical width and held centre, an attained scale exists exactly when some residual magnitude exceeds the width.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a m : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : (∃ s ∈ Ioi 0, IsMaxOn (likelihood x a m) (Ioi 0) s) ↔ ∃ j, a < |x j - m|
dossier_scope_note: Positive-width branch.

statement: Fixed positive Gaussian scale and nonnegative width yield an attained centre for every nonempty sample.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a s : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : 0 < s) : ∃ m, IsMaxOn (fun t ↦ likelihood x a t s) univ m

statement: Fixed width and positive Gaussian scale give a unique centre. The positive-width proof uses strict log concavity of Gaussian interval mass.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a s : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : 0 < s) : ∃! m, IsMaxOn (fun t ↦ likelihood x a t s) univ m

statement: A positive-radius covering interval can reach the full uniform height at all observations, including tied endpoints, when the width can move.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {c r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hx : ∀ j, |x j - c| ≤ r) : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ likelihood x (r+t⁻¹) c ((t⁻¹)^2)) atTop (𝓝 ((1/(2*r))^n))
dossier_scope_note: Moving-width branch reaching the full uniform height.

statement: A positive-radius covering interval can reach the full uniform height at all observations, including tied endpoints, when the width can move.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {c r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hx : ∀ j, |x j - c| ≤ r) : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ likelihood x (r+t⁻¹) c ((t⁻¹)^2)) atTop (𝓝 ((1/(2*r))^n))
dossier_scope_note: Moving-width branch at the held centre.

statement: Constant data at the common location have unbounded normalized likelihood even with any positive tuning cutoff held along the path.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {m c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ∀ j, x j = m) : ∀ B : ℝ, ∃ s > 0, B < logLikelihood x c m s
dossier_scope_note: Also applies at a fixed location when every residual vanishes.

statement: With both location and scale free on constant data, the normalized likelihood is unbounded and has no finite maximizing tuple.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℝ) : let x : Fin n → ℝ := fun _ ↦ m let S := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ LocationScale.domain let L := fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ logLikelihood x p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 (¬ BddAbove (L '' S)) ∧ ¬ ∃ p ∈ S, IsMaxOn L S p
dossier_scope_note: Constant-data branch.

statement: At fixed location and positive scale, increasing cutoff without bound gives the matched normal log likelihood.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : Tendsto (fun c ↦ logLikelihood x c m s) atTop (𝓝 (Normal.logLik x m s))
dossier_scope_note: Fixed-location and fixed-scale path to the matched normal.

statement: Shrinking Huber cutoff with scale proportional to cutoff gives the matched Laplace log likelihood.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) : Tendsto (fun c ↦ logLikelihood x c m (c*b)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Laplace.logLik x m b))
dossier_scope_note: Fixed-location path with scale proportional to the cutoff.

statement: At positive held scale the small-cutoff likelihood vanishes, even when all residuals are zero. This is stated in log likelihood units.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : Tendsto (fun c ↦ logLikelihood x c m s) (𝓝[>] 0) atBot
dossier_scope_note: Vanishing likelihood in log likelihood units.

statement: At held location and scale, finite tuning attains exactly when the loss reduction matches or exceeds the normalizer penalty at some cutoff.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : (∃ c ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (fun t ↦ logLikelihood x t m s) (Ioi 0) c) ↔ ∃ c > 0, (∑ j, (max (|(x j-m)/s|-c) 0)^2/2) ≥ n * log (normalizer c / sqrt (2*π))

statement: With both nuisances held, any failure to attain has the matched normal as the exact supremum, strictly above all finite cutoffs.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : let L := fun c ↦ logLikelihood x c m s let B := Normal.logLik x m s (¬ ∃ c ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn L (Ioi 0) c) ↔ (∀ c ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), L c < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' Ioi 0) B

statement: A nonzero residual gives exactly one conditional scale at each positive cutoff with location held.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ∃ i, x i ≠ m) : ∃! s, s ∈ Ioi 0 ∧ IsMaxOn (logLikelihood x c m) (Ioi 0) s
dossier_scope_note: Unique conditional scale. Finiteness of the stationary cutoff list is separate.

statement: At held scale and constant data every positive cutoff and location strictly loses to the normal at the common observation.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : ∀ c > 0, ∀ u : ℝ, logLikelihood (fun _ : Fin n ↦ m) c u s < Normal.logLik (fun _ : Fin n ↦ m) m s
dossier_scope_note: Constant-data branch.

statement: The held-unit-scale symmetric pair has a winning cutoff in `(0,1/2)`. At that cutoff its entire location maximizing set is the stated interval.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: : ∃ c ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1/2), ∀ m : ℝ, IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ logLikelihood separatedPair p.1 p.2 1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ univ) (c,m) ↔ m ∈ Icc (-10+c) (10-c)

statement: The full held-width-and-centre failure classification, including the zero-width normal collapse and the covered uniform with contact penalties.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a m : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : (¬ ∃ s ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (likelihood x a m) (Ioi 0) s) ↔ (a = 0 ∧ ∀ i, x i = m) ∨ (0 < a ∧ ∀ i, |x i-m| ≤ a)
dossier_scope_note: Failure detector at every nonnegative width. The positive-width envelope value is HeldSweepBhatt.held_centre_supremum.

statement: For a nonempty sample at held location and scale, the tuning score has finitely many roots, including any roots at observed-magnitude joins.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin n → ℝ) : {c ∈ Ioi 0 | (n : ℝ)*(tailShare c/c) - ∑ i, max (|z i|-c) 0 = 0}.Finite
dossier_scope_note: Finiteness via at most two zeros per affine tail score.

statement: The normalized cutoff derivative at held location and scale, including the joins where a residual switches between tail and core.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {s c : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hc : 0 < c) : HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ logLikelihood x t m s) ((n : ℝ)*(tailShare c/c) - ∑ i, max (|(x i-m)/s|-c) 0) c
dossier_scope_note: Stationarity formula valid through residual-magnitude joins.

statement: On every nonempty sample at held location and scale, the set of stationary finite cutoffs of the normalized likelihood is finite.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : {c ∈ Ioi 0 | deriv (fun t ↦ logLikelihood x t m s) c = 0}.Finite
dossier_scope_note: Finite set of stationary cutoffs of the actual normalized objective.

statement: At held location and scale with equal absolute residuals, any attained Huber cutoff is unique.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {s R : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hR : ∀ i, |(x i-m)/s| = R) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hma : IsMaxOn (fun c ↦ logLikelihood x c m s) (Ioi 0) a) (hmb : IsMaxOn (fun c ↦ logLikelihood x c m s) (Ioi 0) b) : a = b
dossier_scope_note: All equal-magnitude cases, including no possible finite winner when the common magnitude vanishes.

statement: At positive held shape and held location, a positive-likelihood scale maximizer exists exactly when some sample residual is nonzero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (m : ℝ) : (∃ s > 0, ∃ p : Fin n → ℝ, (m,p) ∈ heldScaleGraph x lam s ∧ 0 < graphLikelihood lam s (m,p) ∧ ∀ t > 0, ∀ q : Fin n → ℝ, (m,q) ∈ heldScaleGraph x lam t → graphLikelihood lam t (m,q) ≤ graphLikelihood lam s (m,p)) ↔ ∃ i, x i ≠ m
dossier_scope_note: Strictly positive held shape only.

statement: The exact leading term of the log likelihood at zero scale and positive held shape. A zero excess contributes exponent `-1`; each positive excess contributes `1 / ξ`.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (y : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ) : let exponent := ∑ i, if y i = 0 then (-1 : ℝ) else 1/ξ let constant := ∑ i, if y i = 0 then (0 : ℝ) else -(1+1/ξ)*log (ξ*y i) Tendsto (fun s ↦ logLik y s ξ - exponent*log s) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 constant)
dossier_scope_note: Exact leading exponent and multiplier at positive held shape.

statement: At held positive scale and threshold, every nonempty nonnegative excess sample has an attained maximum on the fitted shape domain.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (y : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : ∃ ξ ∈ shapeDomain y s, IsMaxOn (logLik y s) (shapeDomain y s) ξ
dossier_scope_note: All compatible samples, including ties and uniform support contacts.

statement: Moving a feasible nonuniform location toward the sample minimum strictly raises the likelihood at fixed scale and shape.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s ξ m M : ℝ} (hξ : ξ ≠ -1) (h : ξ ∈ shapeDomain (fun i ↦ x i-m) s) (hM : ∀ i, M ≤ x i) (hm : m < M) : ξ ∈ shapeDomain (fun i ↦ x i-M) s ∧ logLik (fun i ↦ x i-m) s ξ < logLik (fun i ↦ x i-M) s ξ
dossier_scope_note: Strict profile to sample minimum on every nonuniform feasible slice.

statement: Every nonempty sample admits a joint threshold and shape maximum at positive held scale on the fitted branch.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : ∃ m ξ, ξ ∈ shapeDomain (fun i ↦ x i-m) s ∧ ∀ q κ, κ ∈ shapeDomain (fun i ↦ x i-q) s → logLik (fun i ↦ x i-q) s κ ≤ logLik (fun i ↦ x i-m) s ξ
dossier_scope_note: Full threshold-and-shape attainment with held scale.

statement: At held scale, every feasible infinite-shape path for which some excess stays uniformly positive has log likelihood tending to minus infinity. The threshold may move along the path.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {A : Type*} {l : Filter A} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (m ξ : A → ℝ) (hξ : Tendsto ξ l atTop) (hvalid : ∀ᶠ t in l, ξ t ∈ shapeDomain (fun i ↦ x i-m t) s) {j : Fin n} {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hj : ∀ᶠ t in l, d ≤ x j-m t) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ logLik (fun i ↦ x i-m t) s (ξ t)) l atBot
dossier_scope_note: Vanishing with at least one positive excess. All-zero trace is held_scale_all_zero.

statement: At held scale, every feasible infinite-shape path for which some excess stays uniformly positive has log likelihood tending to minus infinity. The threshold may move along the path.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {A : Type*} {l : Filter A} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (m ξ : A → ℝ) (hξ : Tendsto ξ l atTop) (hvalid : ∀ᶠ t in l, ξ t ∈ shapeDomain (fun i ↦ x i-m t) s) {j : Fin n} {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hj : ∀ᶠ t in l, d ≤ x j-m t) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ logLik (fun i ↦ x i-m t) s (ξ t)) l atBot
dossier_scope_note: Uniform upper bound when any moving excess stays positive.

statement: Every infinite-shape path at held scale vanishes for nonconstant samples, including when the feasible threshold varies.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {A : Type*} {l : Filter A} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (m ξ : A → ℝ) (hξ : Tendsto ξ l atTop) (hvalid : ∀ᶠ t in l, ξ t ∈ shapeDomain (fun i ↦ x i-m t) s) (hne : ∃ i j, x i < x j) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ logLik (fun i ↦ x i-m t) s (ξ t)) l atBot
dossier_scope_note: Infinite-shape end on any feasible moving-threshold path for nonconstant data.

statement: At the common observation, zero-scale collapse on constant data diverges at every fixed shape, with positive scales remaining feasible.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (ξ : ℝ) : (∀ s > 0, s ∈ scaleDomain (fun _ : Fin n ↦ 0) ξ) ∧ Tendsto (fun s ↦ logLik (fun _ : Fin n ↦ 0) s ξ) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop
dossier_scope_note: The constant-data branch; path at the common observation.

statement: At the fitted uniform shape, for nonconstant data the unique maximum has location at the sample minimum and scale equal to the range.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i j : Fin n} (hi : ∀ k, x i ≤ x k) (hj : ∀ k, x k ≤ x j) (hspan : x i < x j) : ∀ m s, (s ∈ scaleDomain (fun k ↦ x k-m) (-1) ∧ ∀ q t, t ∈ scaleDomain (fun k ↦ x k-q) (-1) → logLik (fun k ↦ x k-q) t (-1) ≤ logLik (fun k ↦ x k-m) s (-1)) ↔ m = x i ∧ s = x j-x i
dossier_scope_note: Exact fitted uniform branch, with closed upper support.

statement: Below the fitted shape floor, finite-density likelihoods are unbounded for every nonempty sample, including constants.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : ξ < -1) : ∃ m, (∀ i, m < x i) ∧ ∀ B : ℝ, ∃ s ∈ scaleDomain (fun i ↦ x i-m) ξ, B < logLik (fun i ↦ x i-m) s ξ
dossier_scope_note: Finite-density points below the fitted branch, including constant samples.

statement: If every eligible conditional knot loses, the right-held Pareto face is the exact unattained global supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {z : Fin n → ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) {l : Fin n} (hl : ∀ i, z l ≤ z i) : let E := log b - b*right z (z l) ((∀ c a, 0 < a → logLik z c a b < E) ∧ IsLUB {v | ∃ c a, 0 < a ∧ v = logLik z c a b} E) ↔ ∀ i a, 0 < left z (z i) → 0 < a → IsMaxOn (fun t ↦ objective (left z (z i)) (right z (z i)) t b) (Ioi 0) a → logLik z (z i) a b < E

statement: A left-held MLE exists exactly when some eligible knot at its conditional right rate reaches the power face. Equality suffices.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {z : Fin n → ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {u : Fin n} (hu : ∀ i, z i ≤ z u) : (∃ c b, 0 < b ∧ ∀ d r, 0 < r → logLik z d a r ≤ logLik z c a b) ↔ ∃ i b, 0 < right z (z i) ∧ 0 < b ∧ IsMaxOn (objective (left z (z i)) (right z (z i)) a) (Ioi 0) b ∧ log a - a*left z (z u) ≤ logLik z (z i) a b

statement: A right-held MLE exists exactly when some eligible knot at its conditional left rate reaches the Pareto face. Equality suffices.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {z : Fin n → ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) {l : Fin n} (hl : ∀ i, z l ≤ z i) : (∃ c a, 0 < a ∧ ∀ d r, 0 < r → logLik z d r b ≤ logLik z c a b) ↔ ∃ i a, 0 < left z (z i) ∧ 0 < a ∧ IsMaxOn (fun t ↦ objective (left z (z i)) (right z (z i)) t b) (Ioi 0) a ∧ log b - b*right z (z l) ≤ logLik z (z i) a b

statement: At held location the collapse detector is exactly the event that every observation equals that location.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) : (¬ ∃ t > 0, ∀ b > 0, logLik x μ b ≤ logLik x μ t) ↔ ∀ i, x i = μ

statement: At positive held width and any fixed centre, the zero-scale trace includes one half at every endpoint contact and vanishes if any observation is outside the closed support.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a m : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : Tendsto (likelihood x a m) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (if ∀ i, |x i-m| ≤ a then ∏ i, (if |x i-m| = a then (1 : ℝ)/2 else 1)/(2*a) else 0))
dossier_scope_note: Fixed positive width, with outside-support zero and every endpoint half factor.

statement: At positive held width and any fixed centre, the zero-scale trace includes one half at every endpoint contact and vanishes if any observation is outside the closed support.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a m : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : Tendsto (likelihood x a m) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (if ∀ i, |x i-m| ≤ a then ∏ i, (if |x i-m| = a then (1 : ℝ)/2 else 1)/(2*a) else 0))
dossier_scope_note: Fixed positive width, with outside-support zero and every endpoint half factor.

statement: Approaching a finite nonuniform upper support contact at held scale forces the likelihood to zero, even when the threshold moves.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {A : Type*} {l : Filter A} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s κ M : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hκ : -1 < κ) (m ξ : A → ℝ) (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 M)) (hξ : Tendsto ξ l (𝓝 κ)) (hvalid : ∀ᶠ t in l, ξ t ∈ shapeDomain (fun i ↦ x i-m t) s) {j : Fin n} (hj : 0 < x j-M) (hcontact : s+κ*(x j-M) = 0) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ logLik (fun i ↦ x i-m t) s (ξ t)) l atBot
dossier_scope_note: Joint finite nonuniform upper contact, including when a threshold is held.

statement: Approaching a finite nonuniform upper support contact at held scale forces the likelihood to zero, even when the threshold moves.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {A : Type*} {l : Filter A} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s κ M : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hκ : -1 < κ) (m ξ : A → ℝ) (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 M)) (hξ : Tendsto ξ l (𝓝 κ)) (hvalid : ∀ᶠ t in l, ξ t ∈ shapeDomain (fun i ↦ x i-m t) s) {j : Fin n} (hj : 0 < x j-M) (hcontact : s+κ*(x j-M) = 0) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ logLik (fun i ↦ x i-m t) s (ξ t)) l atBot
dossier_scope_note: Joint finite nonuniform upper contact with moving threshold.

statement: At a fixed nonuniform fitted shape, nonzero nonnegative excess data have a unique scale optimum precisely on the positive-exponent branch for positive shape, and always at nonpositive shape.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (y : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) (hnz : ∃ i, 0 < y i) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : -1 < ξ) : (∃! s, s ∈ scaleDomain y ξ ∧ IsMaxOn (fun a ↦ logLik y a ξ) (scaleDomain y ξ) s) ↔ ξ ≤ 0 ∨ 0 < collapseExponent y ξ
dossier_scope_note: Exact conditional scale comparison above the uniform floor.

statement: With fitted shape strictly above the uniform, the full joint threshold and scale fit exists exactly on the scale-attainment branch at the sample minimum. Whenever it exists it is unique.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) (hnc : ∃ j, x i < x j) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : -1 < ξ) : let y := fun j ↦ x j-x i (∃! p : ℝ × ℝ, p.2 ∈ scaleDomain (fun j ↦ x j-p.1) ξ ∧ ∀ m s, s ∈ scaleDomain (fun j ↦ x j-m) ξ → logLik (fun j ↦ x j-m) s ξ ≤ logLik (fun j ↦ x j-p.1) p.2 ξ) ↔ ξ ≤ 0 ∨ 0 < collapseExponent y ξ
dossier_scope_note: Threshold profiled to the minimum, nonconstant branch above the uniform floor.

statement: The full held-shape finite-likelihood criterion. A fit exists exactly on the fitted shape branch, on nonconstant data, and, at positive shape, when the exponent at the sample minimum is positive. Every such fit is unique.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i j : Fin n} (hi : ∀ k, x i ≤ x k) (hj : ∀ k, x k ≤ x j) (ξ : ℝ) : let y := fun k ↦ x k-x i let Fit := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ p.2 ∈ scaleDomain (fun k ↦ x k-p.1) ξ ∧ ∀ m s, s ∈ scaleDomain (fun k ↦ x k-m) ξ → logLik (fun k ↦ x k-m) s ξ ≤ logLik (fun k ↦ x k-p.1) p.2 ξ ((∃ p, Fit p) ↔ -1 ≤ ξ ∧ x i < x j ∧ (ξ ≤ 0 ∨ 0 < collapseExponent y ξ)) ∧ ∀ p q, Fit p → Fit q → p = q
dossier_scope_note: All fitted and rejected branches for finite likelihood. The outside-branch extended-real argmax is separate.

statement: At a positive held shape with zero collapse exponent, the scale supremum is the finite zero-scale trace and every positive scale loses.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (y : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) (hnz : ∃ i, 0 < y i) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hA : collapseExponent y ξ = 0) : let H := ∑ i, if y i = 0 then (0 : ℝ) else -(1+1/ξ)*log (ξ*y i) IsLUB ((fun s ↦ logLik y s ξ) '' Ioi 0) H ∧ ∀ s > 0, logLik y s ξ < H
dossier_scope_note: Critical exponent at additionally held positive shape.

statement: At a positive held shape with zero collapse exponent, the scale supremum is the finite zero-scale trace and every positive scale loses.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (y : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) (hnz : ∃ i, 0 < y i) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hA : collapseExponent y ξ = 0) : let H := ∑ i, if y i = 0 then (0 : ℝ) else -(1+1/ξ)*log (ξ*y i) IsLUB ((fun s ↦ logLik y s ξ) '' Ioi 0) H ∧ ∀ s > 0, logLik y s ξ < H
dossier_scope_note: Finite unattained zero-scale value at the observed minimum.

statement: A negative collapse exponent at positive held shape gives unbounded likelihood along the zero-scale path.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (y : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hA : collapseExponent y ξ < 0) : Tendsto (fun s ↦ logLik y s ξ) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop
dossier_scope_note: Divergence when the exponent is negative.

statement: The critical positive-shape trace is the exact joint supremum when location is free. The path at the observed minimum realizes its height, and every feasible finite tuple loses strictly.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) (hnc : ∃ j, x i < x j) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hA : collapseExponent (fun j ↦ x j-x i) ξ = 0) : let y := fun j ↦ x j-x i let H := ∑ j, if y j = 0 then (0 : ℝ) else -(1+1/ξ)*log (ξ*y j) IsLUB {v | ∃ m s, s ∈ scaleDomain (fun j ↦ x j-m) ξ ∧ v = logLik (fun j ↦ x j-m) s ξ} H ∧ ∀ m s, s ∈ scaleDomain (fun j ↦ x j-m) ξ → logLik (fun j ↦ x j-m) s ξ < H
dossier_scope_note: Exact joint least upper bound at critical exponent.

statement: The zero-scale log likelihood at positive shape, with the threshold moving toward an observed minimum, has the same leading scale exponent and the exact additional logarithmic contact penalty.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {A : Type*} {l : Filter A} (y : Fin n → ℝ) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ) (s δ : A → ℝ) (hs : Tendsto s l (𝓝[>] 0)) (hδ : Tendsto δ l (𝓝 0)) (hδ₀ : ∀ᶠ t in l, 0 ≤ δ t) : let H := ∑ i, if y i = 0 then (0 : ℝ) else -(1+1/ξ)*log (ξ*y i) Tendsto (fun t ↦ logLik (fun i ↦ y i+δ t) (s t) ξ - collapseExponent y ξ*log (s t) + ∑ i, if y i = 0 then (1+1/ξ)*log (1+ξ*(δ t/s t)) else 0) l (𝓝 H)
dossier_scope_note: Joint threshold and scale path with the exact contact penalty.
